short_description: Central sector scheme providing end-to-end holistic support, skill certification, toolkit incentives, and collateral-free credit at 5% interest to traditional artisans across 18 trades.
nodal_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
nodal_department: Ministry of MSME & Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
purpose: To strengthen and nurture the Guru-Shishya parampara or family-based traditional skills of artisans and craftspeople working with their hands and tools, ensuring quality products and access to formal value chains.

benefits_summary.recognition: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & Digital ID Card

sources.document_reference: PM Vishwakarma Scheme Guidelines 2023, Ministry of MSME
sources.notes: Covers 18 traditional trades with full interest subvention and toolkit vouchers.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years of age on the date of application.
The beneficiary must be engaged in one of the 18 identified traditional family-based trades on a self-employment basis.
Benefits are limited to one member of a family (husband, wife, and unmarried children).
A person in government service and their family members shall not be eligible under the scheme.
Applicant should not have availed credit assistance under similar central/state schemes (PMEGP, MUDRA, PM SVANidhi) in the past 5 years.

documents.document_name: Active Mobile Number Linked to Aadhaar
documents.description: Required for OTP and e-KYC authentication
Required for DBT credit of stipend and toolkit incentive voucher
Required to verify single beneficiary per family condition
